title: Library Preparation for small RNA sequencing using 4N adapters: In house 4N Protocol C
protocol: Resuspend the 5' adapter at 25 μM.
Resuspend the 3' adapter at 10 μM.
Resuspend the RT primer at 10 μM.
Resuspend the RP1 PCR primer and the indexed PCR primers RPI1-48 at 20 μM.
Combine the universal forward and reverse PCR primers into a cocktail containing 20 μM of each primer.
Add 3 μL of 50% PEG 8000 into each strip tube.
Dry the contents in a speedvac using low heat (37°C).
Cap the tubes once dry and store desiccated at room temperature.
To each strip tube, add x μL RNA.
Pipette 1 μL adenylated 3' adapter (10 μM stock concentration) into each tube.
Add water to a total volume of 5-x μL.
Add 6 μL total mixture to the strip tubes.
Heat tube containing RNA and adapter to 70°C for 2 minutes.
Snap cool the tube on ice.
Add 1 μL of 10X T4 RNA ligase reaction buffer to each tube.
Add 1 μL of RNAseOut RNAse inhibitor to each tube.
Add 1 μL of T4 RNA ligase 2 truncated KQ to each tube.
Incubate the mixture at 25°C for 2 hours.
Add 1 μg of _E. coli_ SSB diluted in 1X ligase buffer and incubate at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Add 1 μL of 5’ deadenylase to the mixture and incubate at 30°C for 1 hour.
Add 1 μL of RecJf to the mixture and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Heat a tube containing 5’ adapter at 70°C for 2 minutes.
Snap cool the tube on ice.
Add 1 μL of 10mM ATP to the denatured 5’ adapter tube.
Add 1 μL of T4 RNA ligase 1 to the denatured 5’ adapter tube.
Incubate the mixture at 25°C for 1 hour.
Add 3 μL of adapter, ATP and ligase mix to the completed 3’ ligation for a total volume of 16 μL.
Heat a new tube to 70°C for 2 minutes, then snap cool on ice.
Add 1 μL of RT primer \(10 μM stock concentration) to the new tube.
Add 6 μL of ligated RNA to the new tube.
Store leftover ligated RNA at -80°C.
Heat the mixture in the new tube to 70°C for 2 minutes, then snap cool on ice.
Add 2 μL of 5x First strand buffer to the mixture.
Add 0.5 μL of 12.5 mM dNTP mix to denatured RNA/primer for RT reaction.
Add 1 μL DTT to the RT reaction mixture.
Add 1 μL RNAseOut to the RT reaction mixture.
Add 1 μL Superscript III enzyme to the RT reaction mixture.
Add water to make the total volume of RT reaction 12.5 μL.
Incubate at 55°C for 1 hour.
Incubate at 70°C for 15 minutes.
Add 1 μL RiboShredder RNAse blend to the RT reaction mixture.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Prepare PCR amplification by adding 25 μL of LongAmp Taq 2x Master Mix, 2 μL Illumina RP1, and 2 μL Illumina RPI1-48 reverse index primer to the cDNA.
Add water to make the total volume of PCR reaction 50 μL.
Amplify for 4 cycles using a program starting at 98°C for 30 seconds.
Cycle through 98°C for 10 seconds, 60°C for 30 seconds, and 65°C for 35 seconds four times.
End with an extension at 65°C for 2 minutes.
Add 100 µL of resuspended room temperature AMPure XP beads to each 50 µL PCR reaction and mix well.
Allow the tube to stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand to collect beads (approximately 2 minutes).
Remove supernatant.
Wash beads with 150 µL of 80% ethanol.
Repeat wash one time.
Remove ethanol.
Allow beads to dry for 5 minutes.
Elute bound material from beads using 23 µL of TE buffer or H₂O.
Add 5 µL of marker 30A for PippinHT to each sample and mix well.
Use 127-156bp for size selection.
Collect eluate in elution well at the end of the run.
Concentrate eluate in speedvac to 22.5 µL.
Amplify using the following program:
98°C 15 sec., 60°C 30 sec., 72°C 20 sec. (11-16 cycles)
Add 100 µL of resuspended room temperature AMPure XP beads to each 50 µL PCR reaction and mix well.
Allow the tube to stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand to collect beads (approximately 2 minutes).
Remove supernatant.
Wash beads with 150 µL of 80% ethanol.
Repeat wash one time.
Remove ethanol.
Allow beads to dry for 5 minutes.
Elute bound material using 23 µL of TE buffer or H₂O.
Add 5 µL of marker 30A for PippinHT to each sample and mix well.
Use 127-156bp for size selection in the PippinHT run.
Collect eluate in elution well at the end of the run.
Concentrate eluate to ~10 µL.
Run 1 µL on a Bioanalyzer DNA 1000 or dilute 1:10 and run on a High Sensitivity DNA chip.
Check library size and purity.
